data_fields.donor_constant: 8 in dmginfo CHUNKING column, code adds 1 (threshold 9)

data_fields.name: chunk_threshold_elemental

data_fields.name: stun_sleep_per_hp_below_one
data_fields.donor_constant: 15 s per HP below one, plus 2 rounds

best_idea: Make a kill overkill by a per-damage-type margin past the victim's HP (a data table, with a fixed PC rule), decide it once in the damage step, and send it as a flag so the client picks a chunked finisher only for those kills.
decision_why: The overkill margin per damage type is a clean, data-driven finisher rule that fits one damage step; we keep it, but fix the unsigned compare, the hidden +1 offset and the death-order coupling, and keep the seven-piece chunk visual client-only with a cap.
acceptance: With a crushing threshold of 9, a 12-point hit on a 2-HP monster gives a chunked kill flag (12 >= 2 + 9) and an 8-point hit does not; a poison hit never chunks; the client shows seven body pieces scattering 5-40 units from the corpse and gone after about half a round; a server test asserts the flag is set from HP and damage, not from the client.
